title: Public TLS certificates are on a shrinking clock. The CA/Browser Forum has voted to cut maximum validity in steps, ending at 47 days in 2029
content_md:
Public TLS certificates are on a shrinking clock. The CA/Browser Forum has voted to cut maximum validity in steps, ending at 47 days in 2029

via Mastodon https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/guidance/provisioning-and-managing-certificates-in-the-web-pki
exclude_reason: NCSC guidance recap of the April 2025 CA/Browser Forum ballot to cut certificate validity to 47 days by 2029; not a new security event.
